description: This file defines classes and functions related to database configuration and backup operations within the vtiger CRM system, including handling database connection settings and performing backup stages.

classes.name: DatabaseConfig
classes.description: Class for managing database connection configurations, including retrieving and setting connection parameters.

classes.name: DatabaseBackup
classes.description: Class for performing database backup operations, managing source and target data streams, and handling backup stages.

methods.name: DatabaseConfig
methods.description: Constructor for DatabaseConfig, initializes database connection parameters.

methods.name: getInstanceFromConfigFile
methods.description: Creates a DatabaseConfig instance from configuration file.

methods.name: getInstanceFromOtherConfig
methods.description: Creates a new DatabaseConfig instance from an existing one.

methods.name: getHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the database connection.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for the database connection.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for the database connection.

methods.name: getRootUsername
methods.description: Returns the root username for the database connection.

methods.name: getRootPassword
methods.description: Returns the root password for the database connection.

methods.name: DatabaseBackup
methods.description: Constructor for DatabaseBackup, initializes source, target, and skip stages for backup process.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source data stream for backup.

methods.name: setTarget
methods.description: Sets the target data stream for backup.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Performs the backup process by iterating over source data and adding stages to target.

methods.name: getLanguageStrings
methods.description: Returns language-specific strings used for error messages.
